question: Where should the Uḍḍiyāna seat with the ca-class syllables be installed?
premises: The Uḍḍiyāna seat is to be placed.
It is associated with the ca-class syllables.
The specified location is the junction of the hair.
inference: One should place the Uḍḍiyāna seat with the ca-class syllables at the junction of the hair.
plain_english: One should place the Uḍḍiyāna seat, beginning with the ca class, at the junction of the hair.
